morphology.pattern_note: 不作马来语词缀拆分；末尾 -tor 不是本条的马来语后缀。原语言和姓名持有者未明，故不指定唯一 IPA。

senses.zh_definition: 维克托：多种欧洲语言使用的男性名字，是 Victor 的一种形式；具体人物须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name used in several European languages, corresponding to Victor.
senses.ms_definition: Nama lelaki yang digunakan dalam beberapa bahasa Eropah dan merupakan bentuk nama Victor.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，不能直接用作马来语名词 pemenang（胜利者）的替代词。不同语言的读音有所不同。马来语释义为编辑说明，并非 DBP 引文；以下是姓名使用示例，未核实为高频搭配。[Viktor 名称资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/viktor)

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报 / 会议安排
dual_scenarios.ms: Encik Viktor akan membentangkan laporan projek dalam mesyuarat esok.
dual_scenarios.zh: 维克托先生将在明天的会议上汇报项目情况。
dual_scenarios.en: Mr. Viktor will present the project report at tomorrow’s meeting.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Viktor dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Viktor sudah tiba di pejabat?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Viktor arrived at the office yet?
spoken_features: 句末 ke 用于口语是非问句

messages.speaker: Farah (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Viktor dah sampai kat pejabat ke?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah Viktor sudah tiba di pejabat?
messages.en: Has Viktor arrived at the office yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (同事)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah. Dia tengah tunggu kat lobi. Aku nak jumpa dia sekarang ni.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba. Dia sedang menunggu di lobi. Saya mahu berjumpa dengannya sekarang.
messages.zh: 到了，他正在大厅等。我现在去找他。
messages.en: Yes, he’s waiting in the lobby. I’m going to meet him now.

etymology.historical_story: Viktor is a form of Victor used across several European languages. The older Latin name Victor carries the meaning of a victor or conqueror. As the name passed between languages, its spelling and pronunciation varied. In a Malay sentence, however, Viktor normally identifies a person; its historical meaning is background information rather than a translation. [Viktor](https://www.behindthename.com/name/viktor), [Victor](https://www.behindthename.com/name/victor)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Viktor 联想英语 victory（胜利），帮助记住名字的历史关联；实际读到时仍译作人名“维克托”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 正式场合可按身份使用 Encik 或合适职衔，并优先采用对方惯用的称呼与读音。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 姓名应写作 Viktor；不要擅自改成 Victor，也不要仅凭名字判断国籍、族群或宗教。
